On it. Two quick notes:
1) Host handoff — I can claim host on our Zoom account and generate an ephemeral meeting ID with host token so the join URL includes the host token, which should survive calendar export. That avoids asking Clearwell to change SSO.
2) Organizer field — if we set the organizer to the Zoom account that owns the ephemeral meeting, some Exchange exports still rewrite the UID; generating a fresh ICS with the meeting URL both in the DESCRIPTION and the X-ALT-DESC (plain-text) helps most enterprise clients.

Marissa — can you reissue the ICS and include the meeting link as plain text at the top of the description and attach the agenda PDF? I can provide the ephemeral link once the slot is confirmed.

Ben
